title: Concept: Image loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: An image whose source is plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The browser treats the image as passive content, so it loads and shows a padlock warning at most, which means the image can be swapped or watched by the network path.
applicability: Deployments that render an image whose source is plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The browser treats the image as passive content, so it loads and shows a padlock warning at most, which means the image can be swapped or watched by the network path.
